meanings.en: the act of ending something
meanings.exampleEn: The termination of the contract left both companies in dispute.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşmenin sona erdirilmesi iki şirketi de anlaşmazlığa düşürdü.

meanings.en: the ending of someone's employment
meanings.exampleEn: He received a letter announcing his termination.
meanings.exampleTr: İşten çıkarıldığını bildiren bir mektup aldı.

meanings.en: relating to the earth or to land
meanings.exampleEn: Terrestrial animals live on land rather than in water.
meanings.exampleTr: Karasal hayvanlar suda değil, karada yaşar.

meanings.en: a person who uses violence to achieve political aims
meanings.exampleEn: The terrorist was arrested before the attack could take place.
meanings.exampleTr: Terörist, saldırı gerçekleşmeden önce tutuklandı.

meanings.tr: kısa ve öz bir şekilde, sert biçimde
meanings.en: in a brief and often unfriendly way
meanings.exampleEn: "No comment," she replied tersely.
meanings.exampleTr: "Yorum yok," diye kısa ve sert biçimde yanıtladı.

meanings.en: a period during which something is tried out or evaluated
meanings.exampleEn: During the test period, users can access all features for free.
meanings.exampleTr: Deneme süresi boyunca kullanıcılar tüm özelliklere ücretsiz erişebilir.

meanings.en: in an easily annoyed or irritable manner
meanings.exampleEn: "I already told you," he said testily.
meanings.exampleTr: "Sana zaten söyledim," dedi sinirli bir şekilde.

meanings.en: easily annoyed and impatient
meanings.exampleEn: He gets testy when he hasn't had enough sleep.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeterince uyumadığında huysuzlaşır.

meanings.en: used to introduce the second part of a comparison
meanings.exampleEn: She is taller than her brother.
meanings.exampleTr: O, erkek kardeşinden daha uzun.

meanings.en: unpleasant to do and not likely to be appreciated by others
meanings.exampleEn: Cleaning up after everyone is a thankless task.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesin ardından temizlik yapmak takdir edilmeyen bir iştir.

meanings.en: the quality of being unrewarding or unappreciated
meanings.exampleEn: The thanklessness of the job eventually wore her down.
meanings.exampleTr: İşin takdir edilmemesi sonunda onu yıprattı.

meanings.tr: belirli tanımlık (bahsedilen belirli bir şey için)
meanings.en: used before a noun to refer to a specific thing already known
meanings.exampleEn: The book on the table is mine.
meanings.exampleTr: Masadaki kitap benim.

meanings.en: the time that will come after the present
meanings.exampleEn: Nobody knows what the future holds.
meanings.exampleTr: Geleceğin ne getireceğini kimse bilmez.

meanings.en: the period of time that is happening now
meanings.exampleEn: We should focus on the present rather than worrying about the past.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçmişi dert etmek yerine şimdiye odaklanmalıyız.

meanings.en: belonging to or associated with the people or things mentioned
meanings.exampleEn: The students handed in their homework.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler ödevlerini teslim etti.

meanings.en: used to refer to something belonging to people previously mentioned
meanings.exampleEn: Our house is smaller than theirs.
meanings.exampleTr: Bizim evimiz onlarınkinden daha küçük.

meanings.en: used as the object to refer to people or things previously mentioned
meanings.exampleEn: I saw them at the party last night.
meanings.exampleTr: Onları dün gece partide gördüm.

meanings.en: used to refer back to a plural subject
meanings.exampleEn: The children made breakfast for themselves.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar kendilerine kahvaltı hazırladı.

meanings.tr: din adına yönetimi savunan/ilahi otoriteyle yöneten kişi
meanings.en: a ruler or advocate of government based on religious authority
meanings.exampleEn: The theocrat justified every law as the will of God.
meanings.exampleTr: Din adamı yönetici her yasayı Tanrı'nın iradesi olarak gerekçelendirdi.

meanings.en: used to refer to plural things near the speaker
meanings.exampleEn: These shoes are too small for me.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ayakkabılar bana çok küçük.

meanings.en: used to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned
meanings.exampleEn: They are coming to visit us tomorrow.
meanings.exampleTr: Onlar yarın bizi ziyarete gelecekler.

meanings.en: not easily upset by criticism or insults
meanings.exampleEn: You need to be thick-skinned to work in politics.
meanings.exampleTr: Siyasette çalışmak için eleştiriden etkilenmeyen biri olman gerekir.

meanings.en: the number 13
meanings.exampleEn: She turned thirteen last week.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen hafta on üç yaşına girdi.

meanings.en: the number 30
meanings.exampleEn: There were about thirty people at the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıda yaklaşık otuz kişi vardı.

meanings.en: used to refer to a specific thing near the speaker
meanings.exampleEn: This is my favourite song.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu benim en sevdiğim şarkı.

meanings.en: used to refer to a particular type of thing
meanings.exampleEn: This kind of behaviour is not acceptable.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu tür davranışlar kabul edilemez.

meanings.en: a sharp pointed part growing on the stem of a plant
meanings.exampleEn: She pricked her finger on a rose thorn.
meanings.exampleTr: Parmağını bir gül dikenine batırdı.

meanings.en: used to refer to plural things at a distance from the speaker
meanings.exampleEn: Those mountains look beautiful from here.
meanings.exampleTr: Şu dağlar buradan çok güzel görünüyor.

meanings.en: the quality of thinking about the needs and feelings of others
meanings.exampleEn: Her thoughtfulness in remembering my birthday touched me.
meanings.exampleTr: Doğum günümü hatırlamasındaki düşünceliliği beni duygulandırdı.

meanings.en: the number 1,000
meanings.exampleEn: The stadium can hold ten thousand spectators.
meanings.exampleTr: Stadyum on bin seyirci alabilir.

meanings.en: the number 3
meanings.exampleEn: I have three brothers.
meanings.exampleTr: Üç erkek kardeşim var.

meanings.en: to vomit
meanings.exampleEn: He felt so sick that he had to throw up.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar kötü hissediyordu ki kusmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: to produce or reveal something, especially problems
meanings.exampleEn: The investigation threw up some surprising results.
meanings.exampleTr: Soruşturma bazı şaşırtıcı sonuçlar ortaya çıkardı.

meanings.en: a jewelled ornamental band worn on the head by women on formal occasions
meanings.exampleEn: The princess wore a diamond tiara at the ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Prenses törende elmas bir taç taktı.

meanings.en: the quality of being neat and well organised
meanings.exampleEn: Her tidiness makes the office a pleasant place to work.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun düzenliliği ofisi çalışmak için hoş bir yer yapıyor.

meanings.tr: toprağı sürme, tarım için toprak işleme
meanings.en: the preparation of land for growing crops
meanings.exampleEn: Modern tillage methods have increased crop yields.
meanings.exampleTr: Modern toprak işleme yöntemleri ürün verimini artırdı.

meanings.en: a bar used to turn the rudder of a boat when steering
meanings.exampleEn: He held the tiller steady as the boat crossed the bay.
meanings.exampleTr: Tekne körfezi geçerken dümen kolunu sabit tuttu.

meanings.en: a machine or tool used for tilling soil
meanings.exampleEn: The farmer used a tiller to break up the hard ground.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçi sert toprağı kırmak için bir çapa makinesi kullandı.

meanings.en: an instrument for measuring time, such as a clock or watch
meanings.exampleEn: He collects antique timepieces from the nineteenth century.
meanings.exampleTr: On dokuzuncu yüzyıldan kalma antika saatler topluyor.

meanings.en: multiplied by
meanings.exampleEn: Four times three equals twelve.
meanings.exampleTr: Dört kere üç, on iki eder.

meanings.en: used to indicate how many occasions something happens
meanings.exampleEn: I have seen that film three times.
meanings.exampleTr: O filmi üç kez izledim.

meanings.en: the quality of being shy or lacking courage
meanings.exampleEn: Her timidity kept her from speaking up in meetings.
meanings.exampleTr: Çekingenliği toplantılarda konuşmasını engelledi.

meanings.tr: hafif iz, az miktar (renk veya duygu)
meanings.en: a small amount of a colour or a feeling
meanings.exampleEn: There was a tinge of sadness in her voice.
meanings.exampleTr: Sesinde hafif bir hüzün izi vardı.

meanings.en: the point at which a series of small changes becomes significant enough to cause a larger change
meanings.exampleEn: Rising temperatures may push the climate past a dangerous tipping point.
meanings.exampleTr: Yükselen sıcaklıklar iklimi tehlikeli bir dönüm noktasının ötesine itebilir.

meanings.en: slightly drunk
meanings.exampleEn: After two glasses of wine she felt a little tipsy.
meanings.exampleTr: İki kadeh şaraptan sonra biraz çakırkeyif hissetti.

meanings.en: expressing direction towards a place or point
meanings.exampleEn: We are going to the beach tomorrow.
meanings.exampleTr: Yarın plaja gidiyoruz.

meanings.en: a thing that represents a fact, quality, or feeling
meanings.exampleEn: Please accept this gift as a token of our gratitude.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen bu hediyeyi minnettarlığımızın bir nişanesi olarak kabul edin.

meanings.en: a piece of metal or plastic used instead of money in machines
meanings.exampleEn: You need a token to use the washing machine.
meanings.exampleTr: Çamaşır makinesini kullanmak için bir jetona ihtiyacın var.

meanings.tr: oldukça, idare eder derecede, katlanılabilir şekilde
meanings.en: to a fairly acceptable degree; reasonably
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel was tolerably comfortable for the price.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel, fiyatına göre oldukça rahattı.

meanings.en: unable to speak because of shyness or nervousness
meanings.exampleEn: He became tongue-tied whenever he spoke to her.
meanings.exampleTr: Onunla konuşurken hep dili tutulurdu.
